capabilities: convert .brz archives or thoughts.json/links.json files into linked Markdown notes
preview note counts, duplicates, and broken endpoints before importing
preserve tags, dates, and labels as frontmatter
write Parents, Children, and Jumps sections from thought relations
optionally import note bodies, copy attachment files, and create a Canvas file
extras: Pro features (note bodies, attachments, Canvas file) require a GitHub Sponsors payment ($5/month or $15 one-time); the free tier still imports notes and links. Import limits: 50 MB per file, 250 MB expanded archive, 10,000 records. The What's new tab suggests other NoteMods plugins and links to notemods.com. Some paths (full exports with bodies and attachments, Linux/Windows/mobile, large exports) were not tested.
problem: Obsidian has no way to convert a TheBrain export, so its thoughts, tags, and parent/child/jump relations cannot be migrated into linked Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: Convert TheBrain thoughts and links into linked Markdown notes.

summary: Importer that converts TheBrain exports (.brz archive or thoughts/links JSON) into linked Markdown notes, with optional note bodies, attachments and a Canvas file.
